design.affected_system: walking, cycling, and shared micromobility network
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for active and shared-mobility trip demand
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for active and shared-mobility trip demand
pair weather-event and land-use conditioned trip forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Trips, counts, facilities, stress levels, barriers, and shared-vehicle states use documented coverage.
Observed shared-system trips do not represent all walking and cycling demand.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
design.baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for active and shared-mobility trip demand.

constraints.description: The active mobility network and micromobility forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

design.decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
design.decision_owner: active transportation director and shared-mobility program manager
design.decision_question: What station, corridor, and time-specific trip and vehicle-availability range should operations prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The active mobility network and micromobility forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for active and shared-mobility trip demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: weather-event and land-use conditioned trip forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: trip requests without feasible vehicle or route capacity

design.intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting active and shared-mobility trip demand, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: trip requests without feasible vehicle or route capacity
distributional gap in trip requests without feasible vehicle or route capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not treat shared-platform demand as total walking or cycling demand.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for active and shared-mobility trip demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

design.title: Forecast active and shared-mobility demand
transportability_risks: Topography, climate, street stress, vehicle access, pricing, and safety perceptions vary.
Platform data can exclude private bicycles, pedestrians, and non-users.

family.affected_system: walking, cycling, and shared micromobility network
claim_boundary: Network, request, and schedule records do not establish individual travel behavior or harm.
Optimized routes and allocations are planning outputs, not dispatched or completed trips.
Design-only records do not claim current city data, implementation, compliance, or impact.
family.decision_owner: active transportation director and shared-mobility program manager
family.description: Eight decisions for network-gap diagnosis, demand forecasting, project selection, station siting, fleet allocation, rebalancing schedules, network stress, and infrastructure evaluation.
family.title: Active mobility network and micromobility

library_claim_boundary: The catalog contains 240 decision designs, not 240 city executions.
Exactly twelve designs map to existing Tier-D reference templates; 228 remain design-only.
A reference implementation can be an explicit negative release and does not imply impact.
No record claims a city binding, new method, deployment, adoption, or real-user outcome.
Future execution requires source binding, gate passage, and domain, legal, community, and operational review.
